evals.prompt: 这是我们客服系统导出的工单数据(support_tickets.csv),麻烦帮我看看数据质量怎么样,顺便做个分析报告,我想知道有没有什么问题或者规律。
evals.expected_output: A cleaned dataset + report noting: 1 exact duplicate row, 1 resolution-time outlier, the channel casing inconsistency, and the two co-located missing values — plus a chart-bearing report file.
assertions: Notes or corrects the exact duplicate ticket row (T-2010 appears twice)
Flags the outlier resolution time (T-2007, 26 hours vs a ~0.5-5 hour baseline)
Notices the channel casing inconsistency ('chat' vs 'Chat') as a data quality issue, not just whitespace
Reports the two missing values (resolution_hours and satisfaction_score, both on T-2004) rather than silently filling them in
Produces a report file with at least one chart, not just a text summary

evals.prompt: 帮我分析一下这份泰坦尼克号乘客数据(titanic.csv),想了解生还率跟哪些因素有关,顺便看看数据本身干不干净。
evals.expected_output: A report that does not chart PassengerId as a measurement, correctly summarizes Age/Cabin missingness, and reports the real survival-rate gaps by sex and class.
assertions: Does not present PassengerId as a meaningful numeric distribution/measurement
Reports missing Age (~177 of 891, ~20%) and missing Cabin (~687 of 891, ~77%) roughly correctly
States survival rate differs by sex with roughly correct direction/magnitude (women much higher than men, ~74% vs ~19%)
States survival rate differs by class with roughly correct direction (1st class higher than 3rd, ~63% vs ~24%)
Produces a report file with at least one chart, not just a text summary
